blockers.effect: Local clean V2 Git history exists, but no authoritative new GitHub V2 remote is attached.
blockers.required_resolution: Create a brand-new GitHub repository (preferred foaryon/SkatAI-V2 or another approved clean name), then attach and push the existing clean V2 history without importing V1 history.

blockers.effect: No ISS_HOST/ISS_CLIENT_ID/ISS_PASSWORD environment variables are currently configured on the V2 RunPod worker, so the clean V2 ISS transport cannot perform an authenticated live session yet.
blockers.required_resolution: Provide/register a dedicated ISS account and inject ISS_HOST, ISS_CLIENT_ID and ISS_PASSWORD through an approved secret mechanism. Do not commit the password.

notes: The saved SentinelX integration SkatAI_V2 is a Hetzner compute integration, not an S3 object-storage interface.
Hetzner S3 access remains direct through the RunPod worker's S3-compatible environment credentials.
